name: Qwen-3.5-397B-A17B
_comment_arch_warning: HYBRID model: 15 full-attention layers interleaved with 45 linear-attention layers. The attention block is given as an explicit shape, averaged over the 60 layers from the published weights: projection parameters 114,294,784 per layer (full layers 104,857,600: query-plus-gate 4096 -> 16384, key and value 4096 -> 512 each, output 8192 -> 4096; linear layers 117,440,512), a cache of 256 elements per token per layer (1,024 on each of the 15 full layers, none on the linear ones, whose state does not grow with the context) and a score/value width of 2,048 (8,192 on the full layers). The averages are exact for a whole replica; with pipeline parallelism the stages are taken as alike, which they are not exactly.
_comment_k_active: 10 routed experts + 1 shared expert (shared_expert_intermediate_size=1024 = I_moe). Shared expert approximated by k=11.
_comment: The input embedding and the LM head are separate matrices in the published weights (`tied_embeddings` false), so memory holds two vocabulary matrices.
